case_information.customer_feedback_summary: Guests frequently praised the location, sea views and multiple seawater pools, spacious rooms, breakfast and helpful, multilingual staff, with positive remarks about restaurants and the spa. Recurrent criticisms included uncomfortable pillows or bedding, repetitive or disappointing evening buffets and charges/not replenishment for bottled water/drinks; some room amenity problems (TV streaming, air conditioning, USB ports), reported rude staff interactions and one food contamination incident.
